hooks.text: 三人英雄小队自由拼接数百技能，打出夸张连携
hooks.excerpt: Build a party of three and combine hundreds of their unique skills to create insane combos.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在Master Raid中权衡强力祝福与残酷诅咒，反复挑战终极远征
hooks.excerpt: The Master Raid is the ultimate roguelike test of your strategy skills! Fight your way through each of Ragnarath’s world crushing bosses, encounter the Mysterious Rogue Rifters, and take the fight to Ragnarath himself! Manage powerful blessings and brutal curses, and watch out!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用全配音动态漫画过场重现90年代周六晨间动画冒险
hooks.excerpt: Teleport yourself back to the glory days of the 90s with the Dimensionals radical story campaign, told through voice-acted, animated, comic-book style cutscenes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
